name: Web-Bench
description: Web-Bench is a code benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on web development tasks based on Web Standards and Web Frameworks. It contains 50 projects with 20 sequentially dependent tasks each, simulating real-world human development workflows and covering foundational web development knowledge and efficiency tools.
reputation: A recent code benchmark for web development that is emerging in the research community but is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Includes 50 projects with 20 sequential tasks each; designed by experienced engineers; addresses benchmark saturation in code generation.
